reviews.title: Great memory support. Don't Buy Refurbished!
reviews.comment: I used this to upgrade from a B350 board that wouldn't support over 3000Mhz ram for some reason with my Ryzen 2600. Upon installation the board took the 3200Mhz memory without issue and I believe there was headroom to go even higher. When I went back to the bios to try and bump the memory up again it loaded a bios that was fully in Chinese and anything you clicked would be stuck on the screen and it would keep layering each page over the top of the last. Not a big problem, I've had another MSI board that did the same thing occasionally. Upon closing the bios though the screen went completely blank and said no signal. I put another gpu in to test and it still read no signal without any troubleshooting LEDs. The board was dead within days of arriving. I returned it but it was good while it lasted. The board was certified refurbished and I suspect it was purely cosmetic, it was likely broken already when it arrived so I got a refund and ordered a different board NEW.
